sentences.text: Kryptohadros is a hadrosauroid dinosaur known from a partial skull and skeleton.
It is the second named non-hadrosaurid hadrosauroid discovered in the Hațeg Basin.
The holotype specimen was recovered between 2022 and 2024 at the Fântânele-3 site in Hunedoara County, Romania.
János Magyar and colleagues formally described the genus and species in 2026.

The generic name combines Greek words for “hidden” and “thick” to reflect its previously unrecognized status in the Hațeg Basin, while the specific epithet honors the describer’s mother, Csilla Kállai.
The holotype represents an individual that had reached at least the subadult stage.
Phylogenetic analyses place Kryptohadros within the endemic clade Telmatosauridae, alongside Telmatosaurus and Tethyshadros.
Kryptohadros lived during the Maastrichtian stage, roughly 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
